message:
fix(host,test): the record-only build performs no IME / input-attach / UIA write either; every child resumes only inside a verified kill-on-close job; records name the session's input they belong to (test-injection-finding r5)

Codex codex_test_injection_finding.md "d9a3a91 SOURCE: NEEDS_CHANGES" N1 N2 T1; verifier r5.

- N1: os_input_effects.hpp also takes AttachThreadInput (6 calls), ImmSetOpenStatus (1), ImmSetConversionStatus (2)
  (host_input_inject.cpp) and the credential field's UIA SetValue clear (logon_ui_target.cpp): in the product they ARE
  the Win32 / UIA calls; record-only records them instead (the IME reads stay real: observation). SetThreadExecutionState
  is r4's. The record-only startup line names exactly what it covers -- and that clipboard writes are not in it.
- T1: each recorded effect carries the dispatch it belongs to -- "ctx what=input|text|release seq=N epoch=E frag=K"
  (os_input::DispatchContext at the three dispatch sites of host_control_session.cpp; nothing in a product build);
  an effect with no dispatch (the wake) is "ctx none". os_input_record_match.hpp pairs each [input]/[input-text]
  injected seq=N with its effects of THIS session's epoch, fragments in order, the required effects in order, only the
  IME preparation allowed besides. Its negative controls (os_input_record_match_test, pure, 9/9): another session,
  a missing unit, units reordered, an effect under another input, an unexpected effect, a fragment gap, records with
  no dispatch, the wake standing in for an input -- each FAILS. os_input_record_e2e uses it; the text is one record
  per UTF-16 unit (units=1 x 2, as apply_input_text_message sends it), not units=2. The before/after cursor and
  foreground comparison is gone (it proves nothing): no-effect rests on the reviewed boundary.
- N2: e2e_adopt_or_invalid(job, pi): the job exists, its limit READ BACK holds KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, the suspended child
  is assigned -- only then resumed; any failure ends the child through its own handle, closes its handles, INVALID.
  At all ten launch sites (os_input_record, android_session_reboot, bwe_observe, host_control_deadline,
  host_two_dispatcher, host_standby_admission (+ its directory), host_punch_reply, host_migration,
  host_reboot_delegate).

All host variants and affected tests build; record_match 9/9, power_policy_record 18/18, injection_guard 20/20.
Not run (the verifier: SOURCE first).
